description: This file defines the KpiMenuConfigurator class responsible for configuring menu items related to KPIs in the OrangeHRM Performance module. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses traits for additional functionality.

classes.name: KpiMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring KPI menu items within the Performance module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen with 'searchKpi' for the current module and screen context, returning null.
